A hundred Wookiee pelts to whoever finds the Jedi.|Babwa Venomor|}} '''Babwa Venomor''' was a [[Trandoshan]] [[commander]] who led others of his [[species]] in helping the [[Galactic Empire]] to strip the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]] of its resources. Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]], he learned that a fugitive [[Jedi]] had [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Force 99)|attacked]] his forces, and led a [[Trandoshan-Imperial convoy]] including Trandoshans collaborators and [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[stormtrooper]]s to locate them. The convoy was then ambushed by the Jedi [[Gungi]] and both the rogue [[Clone Force 99]] and the inhabitants of a nearby [[Wookiee sanctuary]]. During the fighting, Venomor purused Gungi alone into the [[jungle]] with a [[flame cannon]], but after the weapon was destroyed, a trio of [[Kinrath|netcasters]] attacked the Trandoshan and carried him away wrapped in webbing. ==Biography== ===Imperial collaborator=== {{Quote|Commander Venomor, we've found more of those carved stones.''"
"''Stay on schedule. Blast them to dust.|A Trandoshan tank commander and Venomor|}} [[File:VenomorLeader.png|thumb|right|300px|Venomor led a group of Trandoshans that aided the Empire.]] Babwa Venomor was a [[Hunting|hunter]]{{Databank|babwa-venomor|Babwa Venomor}} who acted as [[commander]] of an opportunistic{{Databank|yanna|Yanna}} group of [[Trandoshan]]s that worked in conjunction with the [[Galactic Empire]]. The Trandoshans burned through the lush [[forest]]s of the [[jungle]] [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee]] [[species]],''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' to aid their Imperial allies in stripping the world of its resources and forcing it under Imperial rule. Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|206}} Venomor was contacted via [[hologram]] by a [[Unidentified Trandoshan tank commander|tank commander]] who informed him that their modified [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]] crew and accompanying guards had encountered more standing stones blocking their path in the jungle. Venomor ordered the tank commander to destroy the stones and keep to the schedule before disconnecting; however, after setting the stones ablaze, the tank commander's group was [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Force 99)|attacked]] and [[Death|killed]] by the Wookiee [[Jedi]] [[Gungi]] and his allies in [[Clone Force 99]]. Venomor later arrived in the clearing where the [[tank]] had been destroyed as part of a larger [[Trandoshan-Imperial convoy]]{{InsiderCite|223|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Two Companion}} including two more tanks and several [[Clone trooper|clone stormtroopers]] under his command.{{Databank|flame-cannons|Flame cannons}} Emerging from a tank hatch and sniffing the air, he moved over to the destroyed tank, where the [[Cloning|clones]] had discovered marks from [[Gungi's lightsaber]]. When the clones stated that they would need to inform Imperial command, Venomor declared that would not be necessary if he could locate the Jedi first. Climbing onto one of the tanks, he announced to the other Trandoshans present that he would grant one hundred Wookiee pelts to whoever could find the Jedi first. ===Arachnid ambush=== {{Quote|Ambush!''"
"''Crush them! Take what's left as trophies.|A clone stormtrooper and Venomor|}} [[File:VenomorBetrayer.png|thumb|left|300px|Venomor set one of his own men ablaze while attacking Gungi.]] Venomor's large convoy then followed tracks toward another nearby [[Wookiee sanctuary]], but as the tracks broke off, they were ambushed by Gungi, Clone Force 99 and the Wookiee villagers, who destroyed one of the convoy's tanks with a [[thermal detonator]]. Venomor ordered his men to attack as the opposing force opened fire from the undergrowth, but the Wookiees and their allies soon retreated and drew the Trandoshans and [[stormtrooper]]s further into the jungle before renewing the assault. Venomor watched Gungi disable another of the tanks with his lightsaber before emerging from his own tank with a [[flame cannon]]. Aiming it at the Jedi, he inadvertently set one of his own men on [[fire]] while firing it at Gungi, but the Wookiee managed to avoid the flames and retreated into the forest, drawing Venomor in alone after him. Gungi's allies then drew the commander's remaining forces into a [[Kinrath|netcaster]] nest where they were swarmed and routed. Stalking Gungi through the forest with his weapon ready, Venomor began setting the foliage ablaze as he saw the Jedi dart past him. Soon the Trandoshan was surrounded by a circle of flame, which Gungi leapt into from a nearby [[tree]]. Nimbly dodging the Jedi's [[lightsaber]], he continued to fire the [[Flamethrower|flame cannon]], pushing the Wookiee back when Gungi slashed at him again. [[File:VenomorWebbed.png|thumb|right|300px|Venomor was wrapped in web and carried away by netcaster.]] Realizing the slash had destroyed his flame cannon, Venomor threw it and his satchel aside and prepared to fight with his [[Unarmed combat|claws]], but before he could attack, three netcaster dropped from the canopy above and surrounded him. Gungi deactivated his lightsaber, and no longer seeing the Wookiee as threat, the netcaster began jabbing at Venomor with their [[mouth]] appendages. The Trandoshan attempted to fend them off, but was quickly knocked to the ground and wrapped in webbing. As Gungi leapt to safety from the ring of fire, Venomor was pulled screaming up into the canopy by the netcaster's webbing. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The tracks have broken off. There's no trace of them.''"
"''They can't run far.|A clone stormtrooper and Venomor|}} Venomor was a Trandoshan with [[Color|red]] [[eye]]s and yellow scales mottled with green. He cared only for trophies and bragging rights and was intrigued by the promise of a Jedi survivor as a potential prize. He offered Wookiee pelts as a reward to his men for finding the Jedi, and was willing to risk anything to claim Gungi for himself, preferring to hunt alone and find Gungi himself rather than have the Imperial command alerted. He pursued Gungi with murderous intent, inadvertently setting one of his soldiers on fire and leaving him unaided while pursuing the Jedi. ==Equipment== Venomor wore a blue [[Clothing|uniform]] with [[Hair|fur]] on the left shoulder, a satchel, and a [[comlink]] on his wrist. He had many weapons in his arsenal, but prefered to use his flame cannon when hunting Gungi. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|They fought Babwa Venomor, was the villain.''"
"''That was the Trandoshan.|Dave Filoni and Pablo Hidalgo, on Venomor's planned role in ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars''|{{SWYouTube|7yKM6RExLlI|The Untold Clone Wars Panel | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}}}} [[File:Babwa_Venomor_concept_art.png|thumb|right|300px|Babwa Venomor concept art by Jim Moore for ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] Venomor was voiced by [[JP Karliak]] in "[[Tribe]]," the sixth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} second season, which aired on [[February 1]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} The character was originally created with the name Babwa Venomor for{{ArtStation|subdomain=jimmoore|url=projects/Ywe4V|name=[[Jim Moore]]|text=character concept}} an [[The Clone Wars Legacy#Kashyyyk|unfinished arc]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series set on Kashyyyk, written by [[Matt Michnovetz]].{{Twitter|BFree63|status/565709839247347714|[[Brent Friedman]]|quote=@MattMichnovetz wrote that arc, and he writes for Rebels!|archivedate=20191011213820}} {{C|In response to: "Do you know who wrote TCW Yoda/Wookiees arc? BTW, would love if you could write for Rebels!"}} The "Babwa Venomor" name originated directly from ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] during the arc's development.{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/tribe-episode-guide|text="Tribe" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 6}} Series supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] first mentioned Venomor and his role as the villain of this arc at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] in [[2015]]. Venomor was depicted in a piece of concept art made by [[Jim Moore]] for the arc's first episode, dated [[December 4]], [[2012]], which Moore later uploaded to his ArtStation account. In the unfinished episode, Venomor was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]] with the [[Galactic Republic]]. Venomor and and other Trandoshans—backed by the Confederacy—would have attacked Kashyyyk in [[19 BBY]].{{SWYouTube|7yKM6RExLlI|The Untold Clone Wars Panel | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}} establishes that the events of the [[The Clone Wars Legacy#Kashyyyk|unfinished Kashyyyk arc]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series take place when [[clone trooper]] "[[Echo]]" was a member of [[Clone Force 99]], which happens after the [[Battle of Anaxes]], according to ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''. {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places the events of ''The Bad Batch'' story arc, including the Battle of [[Anaxes]], after ''The Clone Wars'' episode "[[Voices]]," which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[19 BBY]]. Since ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the Clone Wars to 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the [[Kashyyyk]] arc must have taken place in the same [[Standard year|year]]. In response to that trespass, the Wookiees would have then been forced to burn a number of trees to drive the invaders out. The Trandoshan's costume design for the episode consisted of a [[belt]] and a sleeveless blue outfit bearing the Confederacy's [[Separatist hex icon|hexagonal emblem]]. ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Tribe}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|7yKM6RExLlI|The Untold Clone Wars Panel | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}} {{1stm}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/tribe-episode-guide|text="Tribe" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-episode-guides|text=All ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch ''Season 2 Episode Guides Now Available!}} *{{InsiderCite|221|Jedi Master's Quiz}} *{{InsiderCite|223|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Two Companion}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|babwa-venomor|Babwa Venomor}} *{{Databank|flame-cannons|Flame cannons}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Babwa Venomor}} {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{ArtStation|subdomain=jimmoore|url=projects/Ywe4V|name=[[Jim Moore]]|text=character concept}} {{Interlang |es=Babwa Venomor |fr=Babwa Venomor |ja=バブワ・ヴェノモー |ka=ბაბვა ვენომორი |nl=Babwa Venomor }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Venomor, Babwa}} [[Category:Hunters]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Officers]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Trandoshans]]
